recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-31706 unless a future Vocabulary WG decision changes the Identifier Systems/THO migration policy.
issue_request: FHIR-31706 was Published with a Not Persuasive with Modification resolution. Although the original request proposed a NamingSystem extension for identifier system sub-type, the final resolution directed core to remove NamingSystem.type's extensible binding to IdentifierType, create an IdentifierSystemType value set containing all codes from THO v2-0203, and bind NamingSystem.type to that value set with preferred strength.
initial_application: The combined branch did not already contain an Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-31706. In source history, 198c7e0136 applied FHIR-31706 by changing the NamingSystem.type binding and adding valueset-namingsystem-identifier-system-type.xml; ab91e88110 corrected the binding name and value set URL; 91e016a93f corrected value set metadata and the compose include system to http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v2-0203.
additional_context: NamingSystem is active in source/fhir.ini. Later commits adjusted resource/value set metadata, canonical titles, and status bookkeeping without reversing the binding. Vocab minutes place FHIR-31706 in the broader Identifier Systems/THO migration work and explicitly identify the V2 identifier system subtype need; Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting core decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source/namingsystem/structuredefinition-NamingSystem.xml has NamingSystem.type bound with preferred strength to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/namingsystem-identifier-system-type using bindingName NamingSystemIdentifierSystemType, and source/namingsystem/valueset-namingsystem-identifier-system-type.xml includes all codes from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v2-0203.
